comparison.objective: Candidate screens ceramic media away from retained washers; pr-1288 selects and mounts a matching driver bit, power-tightens a drawer knob, load-tests it, and returns the tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires bimanual support of a loose-body screen, controlled agitation, and accurate reseating; pr-1288 requires bit selection and insertion, tool-to-screw alignment, powered axial feed, drawer stabilization, and tool return. Shared tool handling and release are generic.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate uses recovery mass plus washer-retention, spill, support, clearance, and dwell checks; pr-1288 requires stable bit installation, at least 1.3 mm powered screw feed, knob closure, a 5 N hold test, and stable tool return. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Powered fastening with removable-tool assembly and load verification does not test selective many-body screening.
